note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 12(2)(b); A06b Const 12(2)(b); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Uganda, 2024
sources.said: Person has legally and voluntarily migrated to Uganda and has been living there for at least 10 years. ... Renunciation of another citizenship required if a person has more than one foreign citizenship. ... n.a. (note: 2005 constitutional amendment allows retention of citizenship)
